faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Kharagpur is 04 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a four-year Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or a Masters Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or BVSc/BPharm, or a Bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine. Additionally, two years of R&D experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II position is 40 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 33,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II position in this recruitment drive by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-II recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is located in Palakkad, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
